profile.summary: The Springstone School is a nonprofit, independent nonpublic school in Lafayette, California for students in grades 6-12. It serves neurodivergent students, including those with autism, anxiety, ADHD and executive functioning challenges. It offers small classes along with social skills, occupational therapy and mindfulness support. Students attend through private placement or school district referrals under the Individualized Education Program (IEP) process.

review.notes: The Springstone School is an independent nonprofit nonpublic school in Lafayette, CA (ProPublica EIN 48-1293818, 501(c)(3)).
